conversation:
Patient: Hi, I'm Matthew Rogers. I'm 15 years old, and I'm here for an acne follow-up. My skin has been doing better since my last visit, so I wanted to check in and see how I'm doing.
Doctor: Could you describe your current skin condition in more detail? Have you noticed any changes in the severity or appearance of your acne since your last visit?
Patient: My acne has definitely been improving, especially on my face. I've been using the benzoyl peroxide wash and the antibiotic and retinoin cream as prescribed, and I haven't had any irritation or dryness. My face looks a lot better, and I'm happy with the progress.
Doctor: Have you noticed any new acne lesions or changes in the distribution of your acne since starting the treatment?
Patient: No, I haven't noticed any new acne lesions or changes in where the acne is. It's mostly on my face, and it's been getting better. My back and chest haven't had much of an issue, so I haven't focused on them as much.
Doctor: Is there anything else you'd like to discuss regarding your acne or skincare routine?
Patient: Is there anything else you'd like to discuss regarding your acne or skincare routine? Well, I don't have any other concerns right now. The routine I'm doing seems to be working well, and I haven't had any issues with the products. I'm just happy with how my face is looking.
